recipe.title: Tuscan chicken thighs
recipe.prep: Preheat a slow cooker, and start some rice soaking (to cook in rice cooker towards end of cook time).

method.s: Brown the chicken thighs in a hot pan, 2-4 minutes per side. Transfer to slow cooker.
Reduce heat to medium and add onions. Sauté, stirring constantly, for 1 minute. Add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds.
Pour the chicken stock into the pan and cook for 1 minute, gently scraping any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Turn off heat and transfer to slow cooker.
Add the Italian herbs, salt, pepper, and sundried tomatoes to the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on high for 2 - 2.5 hours or on low for 4 - 5 hours.
In a small bowl, whisk together the milk and cornflour. Stir into the slow cooker, along with the spinach. Cook a further 5 - 10 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
